messages:
alex-sales: FinEdge requires BYOK + HSM attestation for their proof-of-concept. They've flagged SIG questions on key custody and want evidence that keys are HSM-backed.
nina-sec: They marked CAIQ s7.6 and s10.2 as non-compliant. We can offer a POC exception with tight compensating controls, but need a formal timebox and audit mechanics.
diego-se: Tech options: 1) Customer imports key material into their CloudHSM and we do cross-account encryption calls; 2) Use KMIP gateway to a partner HSM; 3) Partner HSM (YubiHSM) connected via dedicated secure tunnel. For POC we usually accept cloud HSM import + strict logging.
sam-legal: Legal will only sign off on a scoped, short-lived waiver. Requirements: explicit POC scope, 3-month max term, customer audit rights, liability cap tied to POC, and no plaintext key export. Also need proof of HSM provenance (attestation or cert).
security-bot: Auto-scan: "Risk: HIGH - missing HSM attestation. Recommendation: customer-owned keys, immutable cross-account logs, alerting on GenerateDataKey/Admin events, and MFA+RBAC enforced." Link: https://redwood.internal/reports/1809999999
nina-sec: Suggested compensating controls for a 90-day POC: - customer-managed keys in their HSM/KMS (no key material exported); - cross-account CloudTrail -> S3 with object lock + replication; - real-time alerting on key ops to customer + Redwood; - strict RBAC & MFA for key admins; - limited dataset and retention for the POC; - weekly review calls and immediate revocation playbook.
diego-se: I can stand up the cross-account trail and an alert lambda within 48 hours for the POC. I'll publish a one-page checklist for sales to send: required ARNs, expected events, and the S3 bucket policy snippet.
alex-sales: FinEdge prefers 90 days. They'll sign if we provide the checklist and the addendum.
sam-legal: I'll draft a "POC BYOK/HSM Limited Waiver" one-pager: 90-day term, list of compensating controls, audit rights, termination clauses, and confirmation no plaintext keys will be stored by Redwood. Will post draft here for review.
nina-sec: We'll require HSM attestation (CloudHSM certificate or vendor attestation) and cross-account read access to logs for the customer. One-time exception only; auto-expire at the end of the POC.
alex-sales: Action list: - alex: get FinEdge to confirm HSM vendor and sign addendum. - diego: implement cross-account CloudTrail + alerting, publish checklist. - sam: draft waiver and post for review. - nina: update vendor-risk tracker and mark POC as "controls pending".
diego-se: Publishing checklist tonight. If legal posts draft, I'll wire the alerting runbook to the doc.
alex-sales: Thanks team — i'll follow up with FinEdge now. :thumbsup:
